title: Closed Since Monday
body: The reading room ___ closed since Monday for repairs, so almost everyone is studying in the corridor or in the cafe downstairs.

question.explain_tr: 'since Monday' geçmişte başlayıp süren bir durumu gösterir; bu yüzden **has been** gerekir.

title: The Missing Laptop
body: The student ___ laptop was stolen reported it to the office the same afternoon, and the security team checked the cameras that evening.

question.explain_tr: Sahiplik bildiren ilgi zamiri **whose**'dur: the student whose laptop.

title: On Friday
body: The results ___ published on Friday morning, so there is really no point in asking the office about them before then.

question.explain_tr: Sonuçlar 'yayımlanacak' yani edilgen bir gelecek: **will be + üçüncü hal**.

title: An Extra Course
body: If I ___ more time this term, I would take an extra course, but three lab reports every week already fill my evenings.

question.explain_tr: İkinci tip koşul cümlesi: If + geçmiş zaman, would + fiil. Bu yüzden **had** gelir.

title: Nothing Arrived
body: She said she ___ finish the report by Friday, but nothing arrived and nobody in the group could reach her over the weekend.

question.explain_tr: Dolaylı anlatımda 'will' bir adım geriye gider ve **would** olur.

title: The Match Went On
body: ___ the heavy rain, the match continued until the very last minute and the crowd stayed until the final whistle.

question.explain_tr: **Despite** isim öbeğiyle kullanılır: despite the rain. 'Although' ise cümle ister.

title: Still Playing
body: ___ it was raining heavily all afternoon, the match continued to the end and only a few people left the stadium early.

question.explain_tr: Arkasından özne + fiil geldiği için **Although** gerekir; 'despite' isim ister.

title: Another Language
body: I am seriously thinking of ___ a second language next year, mainly because most job advertisements in my field now ask for one.

question.explain_tr: 'think of' edatından sonra fiil **-ing** alır: thinking of learning.

title: Everyone Available
body: They decided ___ the meeting until everyone in the group could attend, which turned out to be the following Wednesday afternoon.

question.explain_tr: decide fiilinden sonra **to + fiil** gelir: decided to postpone.

title: Before The Deadline
body: We need to ___ this problem before the deadline, otherwise the whole team will lose marks for something only two people caused.

question.explain_tr: 'çözmek, halletmek' anlamındaki öbek fiil **sort out**'tur.

title: A New District
body: I ___ never been to that part of the city before today, although I have lived here for almost four years.

question.explain_tr: Özne I olduğu için yakın geçmiş **have been** biçiminde kurulur.

title: Too Late
body: By the time we arrived at the shopping centre, the bookshop ___ already closed and the lights inside were off.

question.explain_tr: Geçmişteki bir andan daha önce olan iş için **had + üçüncü hal** kullanılır.

title: Your Book
body: The book ___ I borrowed from you last month is on the desk next to the window, exactly where you left your notes.

question.explain_tr: Cansız varlıklar için ilgi zamiri **that** ya da 'which' olur; 'what' bu yapıda kullanılmaz.

title: The Old Route
body: She ___ walk to work every morning, but since the tram line opened she has not done it once.

question.explain_tr: Geçmişteki alışkanlık için **used to + yalın fiil** kullanılır.

title: Called Off
body: The meeting was cancelled ___ the manager was ill, and nobody thought to inform the people who had travelled from another city.

question.explain_tr: Sebep bildiren bağlaç **because**'tur ve arkasından cümle gelir.

title: Saving Up
body: He works two jobs ___ save enough money for his studies, and he still manages to attend every seminar on time.

question.explain_tr: Amaç bildirirken yalın fiil geldiği için **in order to** gerekir; 'so that' özne + fiil ister.

title: Nobody Knew
body: Neither the students nor the teacher ___ informed about the room change, so everyone waited outside the wrong door for twenty minutes.

question.explain_tr: 'Neither ... nor' yapısında fiil kendisine en yakın özneye uyar: the teacher **was**.

title: Too Late To Say
body: You ___ have told me earlier about the change; I would have cancelled my other plans and come with you.

question.explain_tr: Geçmişte yapılmayan ama yapılması gereken bir şey için **should have + üçüncü hal** kullanılır.

title: Waiting For News
body: I look forward ___ from you soon, and I am happy to send any other document the committee might need.

question.explain_tr: 'look forward to' kalıbındaki to bir edattır, bu yüzden fiil **-ing** alır.

title: A New Dish
body: This is the first time I ___ tried this dish, and I am already thinking about how to cook it at home.

question.explain_tr: 'It is the first time' kalıbından sonra yakın geçmiş gelir: **have tried**.

title: Two Readers
body: Every report ___ by two different people before it is sent to the client, which is why small mistakes rarely survive.

question.explain_tr: Raporu başkası kontrol ettiği için edilgen yapı gerekir: **is checked**.

title: When You Finish
body: ___ you have finished the exercise, you can leave the room quietly without waiting for the others to complete it.

question.explain_tr: '... -diğinde, bir kez ... olunca' anlamı **Once** ile verilir.

title: Let It Go
body: There is no point ___ about something you cannot change; put that energy into the parts of the project you actually control.

question.explain_tr: 'There is no point' kalıbı **in + fiil-ing** ile devam eder.

title: Two Qualities
body: She is not only clever ___ also extremely hard-working, which is a combination the department does not see very often.

question.explain_tr: Kalıp sabittir: **not only ... but also**.

title: One More Draft
body: The teacher made us ___ the essay again because half the class had ignored the question and written about something else.

question.explain_tr: 'make somebody do' yapısında to kullanılmaz: made us **write**.
